Figure 1: NeuroAct’s dual-loop autonomous research framework. The Coordinator decomposes an EEG objective into parallel questions and directs separate cycles involving the Researcher, Developer, and Reviewer. The inner loop selects actions from reviewed evidence and experimental feedback within budget. The outer loop distills, matches, applies, and revises conditional experience across tasks. Capabilities are disclosed on demand; the lower panels show four evaluation settings.
